headline: Did I miss my chance, or has love just not happened yet?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/drafts/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing LONELINESS_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. Nothing on the backs showed it, but your hand found the card where nothing has been taken away.
The cup, coin, blade and wand all remain on his table.
You asked whether you missed your chance or love has not happened yet. What catches me is that every tool remains.
Love has not happened, and you are searching for a chance you may have missed.
Just as possibility should become a meeting, something appears. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what that is…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You chose without seeing him and found the figure who has not moved past.
He stays in the picture, held by one ankle.
You asked whether a chance passed you. This card makes me look at the pause itself.
Still, there is no relationship, and your question is looking backward for it.
There's something between the pause and the relationship. I don't think it began with you.
Let me see what's holding this…
c: You turned the Fool. The card was hidden, yet your hand went to the only one in full sun.
The full sun is high behind the Fool.
You asked whether the important moment is already behind you. The full light on this card holds my attention.
But love has not begun, and “missed” has placed the chance in the past.
What has hold of the beginning keeps it from taking shape. I don't think this began with you.
Now let me look at what has hold of this…
